$comment: The source of sf-tag's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/tag (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

kind.summary: What the tag carries: a checkbox, an icon, a colour, an avatar, or nothing but its label. The compatibility input quantity is still accepted and means default.

status.summary: What the tag reports, in the shared status vocabulary, for a tag a person presses or removes (interactive or closable): the same hue as the badge of that status. On a tag that is neither, the status draws the tonal badge of that status instead (owner decision C140 (6)). Leave it empty for a tag that reports nothing.

appearance.summary: Visual appearance, read from the neutral alpha ramp and separate from kind: outline keeps a faint fill and a hairline edge, ghost keeps nothing until it is hovered. surface is outline's former name until 2027-01-01 (journal value-tag-appearance-surface-to-outline; C15 retired the word) and draws the same. Only the neutral kinds take it, because a status tag carries its meaning in its colour.

size.summary: Framework size token: sets the label text and the default spacing.

line.summary: Takes the text line of this form size as an inline tag one size down, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height. Overrides size and inline.

height.summary: The tag's height (owner decision C27, as sf-button): the size's tightness steps -- low, default, high, highest, the size's usual step and its neighbours on the height ladder -- through the class sf-tag--height-<height> of component.tags (none for default). A value outside the list reads as default.

spacing.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (journal attribute-tag-spacing-to-height): the former name of height. compact, comfortable and spacious draw as low, high and highest; height wins when both are given.

inline.summary: Sit on the text line of another control: no block padding, a flush label, and a remove button the height of the line. The host may publish --sf-tag--line.

href.summary: The address the tag leads to: the tag is one native link, with no check mark and no cross, its label underlined on hover (owner decision C145 (6)). A relative address is kept; with a scheme only http, https, mailto and tel

key.summary: The tag's id in sf-tag-group (its selected and selected-ids); empty: the tag's text

count.summary: The text of the count after the label: a number or a capped one such as 99+

color-class.summary: Framework semantic background utility for the color marker.

color.summary: A colour from data for kind color: a hue of the static palette by name (red, teal, violet...) or a hex colour, drawn in the palette hue nearest it, never as the raw colour. The tag shows it as a dot of the point step before the label (8 on the default 1/2 tag) and stays neutral (owner decision C145 (7))

avatar-image-url.summary: Avatar image URL; the visible text remains the accessible label.

avatar-status.summary: Reserved avatar status value for compatible templates.

disabled.summary: Disable interactive toggle and close actions.

closable.summary: Absent: removable for the icon, color and avatar kinds, not for checkbox and default; present, it says so for any kind

interactive.summary: Render the label as a button next to the remove action, for tags that open something (for example a filter chip menu); ignored for checkbox tags.

close-label.summary: Accessible name of the remove action. Defaults to Remove, or Удалить on a Russian page.

active.summary: A checkbox tag is chosen; the tag toggles it and reports it with change

change.summary: The active state of a checkbox tag changed.

relations.name: badges
$comment: A status tag that is neither interactive nor closable draws the tonal
badge of its status (owner decision C140 (6)): the badge's class sheet.

relations.name: cl-button-close
$comment: The remove button: sf-button-close, plain (owner decision C14).

relations.name: cl-icon
$comment: The icon of an icon tag and an avatar's placeholder are sf-icon elements,
so their names reach the icon font request (buttons review 2026-11-09).

relations.name: tooltip
$comment: A name cut with an ellipsis has its whole text in the Framework's plain
tooltip (owner decision C58; tags study TG-1): the tooltip controller.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: A checkbox tag is a native toggle button (aria-pressed), its check mark drawn only when it is chosen (C145 (2)); a tag with href is one native link, no check mark and no cross (C145 (6)); an interactive one is a native button beside the remove action; any other kind is a static label. The remove action is a separate native button named by close-label. A long name ends in an ellipsis; the label stays whole in the markup and the whole name is the tag's tooltip (C58). Closable tags in one row inside a field (.sf-input-field) are one Tab stop: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight walk them, Home and End go to the ends, Delete or Backspace removes the one stood on (sf-tag-close) and the focus goes to its neighbour; each step is said in a polite live line, «Москва, 1 из 3, Delete — убрать» (lang runtime position), as sf-input-lookup's chips (C139 (6)). In a one-row container the tags that do not fit leave the row and a plain count «+N» stands after the last one shown, its title naming them (lang runtime more).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-tag for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
the old DOM name of the request; the element left the detail (§8), the rest is the same
rows.summary: Removal was requested from the separately named close action.

rows.note: journal value-tag-quantity-to-default; the number stays in count

x-summary: Compact static, selectable and removable labels with one explicit interaction owner.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.change: 1 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.close: 1 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-tag-close → close (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
x-decisions: a11y-role: button for the checkbox kind (a native toggle button with aria-pressed) and for an interactive tag (a native button beside the remove action); any other kind is a static label with no role, its remove action a separate native button named by close-label. accessibility.$comment says so; the name is aria-label, else the text.
key-effects: Space and Enter are toggle:active for the checkbox kind (the native button toggles, change follows), Tab reach; probe.json drives Space (gate 16).

events (§8): change keeps the browser's name and carries {active}; close is sf-tag-close and the old DOM name close its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json). The element (component) leaves both details, as §8 says; no Framework code read it.

existing-aliases: type, which answered kind and status from one list, stays routed in code -- a content word reaches kind, a status word status (journal attribute-tag-type-split, public-api-axes) -- and each use is now noted in SF.deprecations with its dates; a setting alias names one target and cannot split. The kind value quantity is a dated value alias of default (journal value-tag-quantity-to-default).
number-type: count stays a string -- it is the text after the label, a number or a capped one such as 99+ -- not a number (§4.2, §16 item 29).
closable is optional (§4.2): absent, the kind decides (icon, color and avatar remove, checkbox and default do not); present, it decides for any kind.
close-label defaults to the language file's runtime.remove (§11), read with sfWord; the module's TAG_TEXT is gone.
active moves to values: it is what the tag holds and reports with change; it keeps its default, so a page that wrote active still writes the attribute (§4, §4.3).
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (Дизайн, default, removable) plus a chosen checkbox, a status, an icon tag, a count, the outline appearance, an interactive chip and a tag on a line.
css-variables: the six public variables of src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json the class sheet already reads (§6).

folder: tags takes the tag's name, tag (§3, §21, §16 item 16); the loader bundle is cl-tag, cl-tags is a Loader forward (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json) and smart/tags/js/tags.js a forwarding script (css/tags.css its sheet) until 2026-12-01 (change journal path-smart-tags-to-tag). The registry id follows the folder: smart.tag (smart.tags is its dated alias in the same record).
version 1.1.0: renamed members behind dated aliases are a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.6: the remove button keeps to the label's line at every size. The tag asked sf-icon-button for size 1/4 at sizes 1/2 and 1/3, a size the button does not have, so it fell back to size 1; and the close rules of the class sheet (.sf-tag > .sf-icon-button) never reached the Smart markup, where the native button sits under the display:contents host, so the button kept the tag's insets as padding. Measured before: a removable tag stood 40px at 1/3 (24 without the button), 38 at 1/2 (32) and 50 at 2 (48); an inline one 20.39 on a 16px line at 1/3. Now the tag asks for 1/3, the button's smallest size, at every size (js/close-size.js) and its sheet draws the box: no padding, the mark 0.7 of the label's font size, an inline tag's button the line square, a transparent target of --sf-c2 around the mark (WCAG 2.2, 2.5.8). Beside a label that is a button (interactive, checkbox) the close moves off by what the target reaches past the mark, so the target never lies over the label and those tags are a few pixels wider. A removable tag is as tall as one without the button at every size. Migration: none -- no setting, event or class changes; a page that capped the tag's height around the button (sf-lookup 1.0.0 did) can drop the cap.

version 1.1.7: an icon no longer moves the tag. The tag took its baseline from the icon, whose metrics change while it loads, so a printed tag stood 1-2 px low until the code adopted it (gate 24). The icon's layout is contained.

version 1.2.0 (owner decision C14; docs review R032, R036): the remove cross is a step of the cross ladder (--sf-tag--close-size: 1/4 at tag sizes 1/3 and 1/2, then 1/3, 1/2 and 1) with the 2px line of every cross, where it was 0.7 of the label's font size and its line fell to 1.05-1.75px; and it is plain: the tag's ink at the step 64 at rest, full on hover and press, no spot. Markup, settings and events unchanged.
version 1.2.1: the first-paint snapshot is retaken: a nested sized component now carries data-sf-size-relative at first paint (density C22, core.runtime 1.45.0); nothing it draws changes.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-09): status="info" draws its dot and its colours: information is a status like the others (C16, the background system, owner 2026-11-08); the class sf-tag--info is new in component.tags.

version 1.3.2 (2026-11-09): the icon draws (buttons review 2026-11-09 on pair ui-b4a77681f0a7). An icon tag printed a bare <i class="sf-icon sf-tag-icon"> after the page's icon scan, so its name never reached the icon font request (label was missing from icon_names) and the glyph stayed blank; an avatar tag without a picture had the same bare person glyph. Both are sf-icon elements now (root-class sf-tag-icon on the icon), the path every other component takes, and cl-icon is a relation; component.tags 1.2.1 sizes the glyph inside an sf-icon by the same size rules. Settings, values, events and classes unchanged; tests/browser/tag-icon-glyph.browser.mjs.

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-10, pair ui-a0370c0c99fb acceptance, F3): a patch. The remove button is asked for appearance ghost, not link, its former name: every closable tag counted as the page's own use of sf-button-icon appearance link in SF.deprecations. Drawn the same (both are the ghost look).

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-10): a patch (R074 F3). The tag asks the Loader for the glyph it draws (an icon tag's icon, sell when none is named; an avatar tag's person placeholder) when it connects and when it draws, as sf-segmented does, so the name is in the page's first icon request instead of a second one 50-140 ms later (on a slow service the icon was blank until the full font arrived). Nothing drawn differently; settings, values, events and classes unchanged.

version 1.3.4 (2026-11-10, pair next integration): one number above both 1.3.3 notes above, which separate branches each claimed with other content: the remove button asked for appearance ghost (a0370 acceptance F3) and the glyph asked for on connect (R074 F3). They ship together in this release; 1.3.3 is never published alone. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.5 (2026-11-10, sf-input-lookup precheck LK-06): a patch. The remove button is sf-button-close, plain (owner decision C14: a tag's remove has no spot, the cross darkens on hover and the keyboard ring stands around it); it was sf-button-icon kind="close", the name C14 retired. The box, the cross and its 2px line are as before (the tag still asks for size 1/3 and draws the box from its line); the base of the plain ink is the tag's colour; a disabled tag's cross takes the disabled ink (on-disable). The rule loads cl-button-close in place of cl-button-icon. With component.tags 1.2.2, an avatar on a line tag is the line (24 at line 1 on a desktop, 20 on a phone; it was the tag's own text line, 20 and 16). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. Also: the empty scss/_smart__tag.scss is gone: no bundle imported it and it held nothing (audit of dead Smart sheets, 2026-11-11); nothing drawn differently.

version 1.3.6 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The sheet reads the C16 roles by their current names where it read the former ones, which are var() of them wherever they are declared (src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json, sf-role-aliases): --sf-disable → --sf-surface-disabled. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.6, also (2026-11-11, audit W8, choice controls): with component.tags 1.2.2 the check of kind checkbox is a checkbox box of the tag's size, the tag's text line, its mark at the tag's text size; it was 16 at every size.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-10, docs precheck TG-02): a minor. The setting height (low, default, high, highest; default default) picks the tag's height from the size's tightness steps, as sf-button does (owner decision C27), through the class sf-tag--height-<height> of component.tags 1.3.0. spacing, which set the same block padding under the buttons' former density names, is deprecated (journal attribute-tag-spacing-to-height, until 2027-01-01): compact, comfortable and spacious draw as low, high and highest, height wins when both are given, and the page's spacing is noted once in SF.deprecations and the console. The tag prints sf-tag--height-* in place of spacing-*. appearance="outline" names the faint fill with a hairline edge (applied decision on docs precheck smart content, d); surface, the word C15 retired, is its dated value alias until 2027-01-01 (journal value-tag-appearance-surface-to-outline), drawn the same and noted once; colours unchanged (fix/backgrounds-c41-c42 owns them). An active or disabled tag keeps its size's height (component.tags 1.3.0; docs precheck smart content TG-01: an active checkbox tag of size 1/2 grew from 32 to 36, 28 to 32 on a phone). An avatar tag's picture address is a quoted url(). Events and keys unchanged.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C140 (6), badges study control/research/2026-11-14-badges.md BG-6): a minor, a look. A status belongs to a tag a person presses or removes: a tag with status that is neither interactive nor closable draws the tonal badge of that status (sf-badge--tonal sf-badge--<status>, class sf-tag-badge), the badge's size for a row of the tag's size (1/3 for sizes 1/3, 1/2 and 1; 1/2 for 2; 1 for 3) or on the tag's line; it drew a tag with a status dot, the same mark as a tonal badge in another shape and a step taller (28 beside 24 on the phone). The badge's root takes the tag's root-class and root-style, as the tag's root did. Interactive and closable status tags are unchanged; their colours are the badge's hue of that status (container fill, status ink), info, success, warning and error alike. Relation badges added (the class sheet). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

row (1.7.0, owner decision C58, C139 (6); tags study TG-1, TG-2, TG-8): a tag ends a long name in an ellipsis, is at most 20rem and its container, and has its whole name as a tooltip; it never shrinks in a row. The row the tags share is read in js/tag-row.js, no group element (an open owner question): a one-row container shows what fits and «+N» (a count, no panel: what it opens is an open owner question); closable tags in a field are one Tab stop with the lookup chips' keys. Outside a field each cross stays a stop (open question #q-keys). Hosts that lay out their own chips (sf-input-lookup, sf-dropdown) are left alone.

version 1.8.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C145 (2), (3)-(7); tags study control/research/2026-11-14-tags.md #q-selected, #q-group, #q-keys, #q-more, #q-link, #q-color): a minor. (2) A filter tag (kind checkbox) shows no mark until it is chosen: the empty checkbox square on every tag is gone; chosen, a check mark (the icon check, the picture of the tag's size, tag - 8) stands before the label on the primary container fill, in the fill's ink (on-primary-container); disabled and chosen, the disabled ink. (6) href: the tag is one native link (a.sf-tag.sf-tag--link), with no check mark and no cross whatever its kind and closable say; its label underlines on hover; a disabled link has no href and aria-disabled. An address with a scheme other than http, https, mailto or tel is dropped. (7) color: kind color draws a dot of the static palette hue (by name, or the hue nearest a hex) at the point step of the tag's size (C132: 6 / 8 / 12 / 12 / 16 at 1/3 ... 3; 8 on the default tag), the tag stays neutral; color-class still paints the dot. (3)-(5) key: the tag's id in the new sf-tag-group, which owns its row (one Tab stop, «+N» that opens the hidden tags in a popover); a tag in a group leaves its row to the group. Tag heights are not changed (#q-height-context waits).

$comment-after: The bundle's former name cl-tags (the folder was `tags` until standard
1.3.8 §3, §21 gave it the tag's name) is not a rule here: a rule of type
smart is a Smart component to the registry, and this one has no element. The
Loader forwards it to cl-tag from src/core/contracts/

static.const: Default, icon, color, avatar and status tags are labels without an action role or Tab stop.

selection.const: Checkbox tags render one native toggle button and expose active through aria-pressed.

removal.const: A removable value keeps its surface static and exposes one separately named close action.

events.const: A successful toggle emits one change event; a successful removal emits one close event. Disabled controls emit neither.

presentation.const: Tag geometry uses semantic UI, typography, role-color and motion tokens; static tags do not gain action hover affordance.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-tag for a compact category, filter, selected value or status with an explicit static, toggle or remove owner.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not make a static tag focusable
Do not nest a toggle and remove action in one tag surface

accessibility.focus: Only native toggle and close actions enter Tab order. Focus is keyboard-visible, geometry-stable and forced-colors-safe.

changes: Add interactive: the label becomes a native button beside the separate remove action, so the tag is reachable by Tab and opens with Enter or Space.
Without interactive the markup is unchanged.

close.summary: Removal was requested from the separately named close action.

component.description: The sf-tag element; the host removes it.

onToggle.summary: Toggle an enabled checkbox tag and emit its new active state.

onClose.summary: Emit removal intent for an enabled closable tag.

root-class.description: Framework utility classes for the visible root.

aria-label.description: Optional accessible name override for a selectable tag.

type.description: Legacy name that answered both questions from one list: a content word reaches kind, a status word reaches status. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.
